epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #38
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻送子鳥和鯨頭鸛到節目做秀。牠倆都有大而實用的喙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Stork and a Shoebill to the show. Both of these animals have large and useful beaks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #39
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一匹野馬和一隻火山兔到節目做秀。牠倆都是瀕危物種,目前正被保育救助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Wild Horse and a Volcano Rabbit to the show. Each of these animals is an endangered species and is being helped through conservation efforts.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎獵豹和湯氏瞪羚來到節目。節目重點是獵食者的習性和動物的速度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Cheetah and a Thomsons Gazelle to the show. Show elements focus on predatory habits and animal speed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海豚和果蝠來到節目。即使牠們的棲息地南轅北轍,但同樣使用迴聲定位來導航。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Dolphin and Fruit Bat to the show. Both animals use echo-location for navigation despite their very different habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們協助新的交通督導員香蕉樹先生工作。但如他變得太擅長自己的工作會怎樣呢?看看結果如何!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Mr. Banana Tree with his new job as a traffic controller. But what if he becomes too good at his job? Find out what happens!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些螃蟹付錢給紅鬍子來觀看一場壯觀的馬戲表演。不過,因為莫里士不是最偉大的表演者,所以螃蟹十分生氣!孩子們能幫忙拯救這場表演嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some crabs pay Redbeard to watch a spectacular circus show. However, Maurice is not the greatest showman. The crabs are angry! Will the children be able to help save the show?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添所有的魔術把戲都失效了。一定是他的魔杖壞了!小孩們前往沙漠尋找新魔杖,但最終得到了比他們想像更強大的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All of Tims magic tricks are failing. It must be because his magic wand is spoilt! The children head to the Desert to get a new magic wand but they end up with something more powerful than they could ever imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寶拉的郵遞服務有了第一位付費客戶!寶拉和她的團隊在運送包裹時遇上麻煩。他們將如何確保成功交付呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Paulas Postal Service has its first paying customer! While delivering the package, Paula and her team run into trouble. What will they do to ensure they make a successful delivery?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們和莫里士試圖讓紅鬍子在拍照時微笑,但似乎沒有甚麼成效。甚麼能讓紅鬍子微笑呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Maurice are trying to get Redbeard to smile for a photo, but nothing seems to be working. What will make Redbeard smile?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子賣廣告招募新的海盜助手,並承諾給最好的助手提供一輛帥氣的電單車。阿添和鑿奇非常想得到電單車,並爭相取悅紅鬍子,因而犧牲他們的友誼,這樣值得嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Redbeard advertises for new pirate assistants with the promise of a cool motorcycle for the best assistant. Tim and Calc want it badly and compete to please Redbeard. Will this be worth sacrificing their friendship in the process?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們前往遠東參加小豬與熊貓的喜劇才藝表演。但原來是開這些孩子的玩笑,最後會如何發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children head to the Far East to join Pig  Pandas comedy talent show. But what happens when the jokes are played on the children?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃氏兄弟、蘇美和小孩們進行一場史詩式的運動大戰。女孩們會玩空手道,男孩們會玩體操。最後到底誰勝誰負?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wong Brothers, Sue-Mae and the children have an epic sports battle. The girls will do karate and the boys will do gymnastics. Who will win?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由給三趾樹懶洗澡,洗掉了牠的偽裝!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo gives a Three-toed Sloth a bath and washes its camouflage away!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠幫助彼由與一隻羊駝成為朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help Peyo befriend a Llama.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由被困在一棵樹上,而一條蟒蛇就掛在他的頭上。小遊俠能及時找到他嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo is stuck in a tree with an Anaconda hanging right above him. Can the Junior Rangers get to him in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場森林大火爆發了!小遊俠在他們的新朋友-善於交際的水豚的幫助下,將動物們運送到安全的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A forest fire breaks out! Its up to the Junior Rangers to ferry the animals to safety, with a little help from their new friend, a sociable Capybara.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由做了一些讓彼高不高興的事。他飛走後就沒有再回來。小遊俠瞭解托哥巨嘴鳥後,嘗試找出彼高可能去了哪裡。小遊俠能否讓彼由和彼高重歸於好?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo does something to upset Pico. He flies away and doesnt return. The Junior Rangers learn about Toco Toucans to try and figure out where Pico might have gone. Can the Junior Rangers bring Peyo and Pico back together again?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠幫助一隻比冰箱還重的加拉帕戈斯象龜翻身,再次腳踏實地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a Galapagos tortoise - which can weigh more than a fridge - flip back on its feet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由被困在河中央,周圍都是可怕的河怪。小遊俠能救出他嗎?這些河怪真是看上去般可怕嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo is stranded in the middle of a river, surrounded by scary river monsters. Will the Junior Rangers be able to save him? Are these river monsters as scary as they seem?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠找到一隻走失的吸血蝙蝠嬰兒。他們能找到牠的家,並把牠安全地送回家人身邊嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a lost baby vampire bat. Will they be able to find its home and return the baby bat to its family safely?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 其他蟲子發現史角可以模仿牠們所有蟲子,牠模仿得過火直至夢見自己失去了聲音。牠必須去迴音仙子那兒重獲聲線。/ 霉菌侵入蛛華士整個巢穴,牠舉家都要依靠陽光派鄰居的慷慨,牠也學到了寬容的真正意義。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the other bugs discover that Squirt can imitate them all, he overdoes his mimicry until he dreams that he’s lost his voice./ When a mold infestation covers Spiderus’ lair, he and his family have depend on the generosity of their Sunny Patch neig

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在立春前夕,史角是一隻興奮的小蜘蛛。春天來了,是時候喚醒牠最好的朋友青蛙菲利斯。菲利斯一直在享受漫長的冬眠。但冬未去,春未來,牠也未準備好春甦,史角充滿樂趣的計劃泡湯了。/ 小龍厭倦了絲網,抓住機會當一天蜜蜂。但牠很快就發現當一隻蜜蜂雖然令人興奮,但也需要付出很多努力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the eve of the first day of Spring, Squirt is one excited little spider. Spring is here and its time to wake up Felix the frog, his best buddy. / Dragon, bored of web-testing, jumps at the opportunity to be a Bee for a day. But he quickly finds o

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 其他蟲子發現史角可以模仿牠們所有蟲子,牠模仿得過火直至夢見自己失去了聲音。牠必須去迴音仙子那兒重獲聲線。/ 霉菌侵入蛛華士整個巢穴,牠舉家都要依靠陽光派鄰居的慷慨,牠也學到了寬容的真正意義。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由給三趾樹懶洗澡,洗掉了牠的偽裝!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo gives a Three-toed Sloth a bath and washes its camouflage away!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠幫助彼由與一隻羊駝成為朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help Peyo befriend a Llama.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由被困在一棵樹上,而一條蟒蛇就掛在他的頭上。小遊俠能及時找到他嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo is stuck in a tree with an Anaconda hanging right above him. Can the Junior Rangers get to him in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場森林大火爆發了!小遊俠在他們的新朋友-善於交際的水豚的幫助下,將動物們運送到安全的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A forest fire breaks out! Its up to the Junior Rangers to ferry the animals to safety, with a little help from their new friend, a sociable Capybara.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由做了一些讓彼高不高興的事。他飛走後就沒有再回來。小遊俠瞭解托哥巨嘴鳥後,嘗試找出彼高可能去了哪裡。小遊俠能否讓彼由和彼高重歸於好?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo does something to upset Pico. He flies away and doesnt return. The Junior Rangers learn about Toco Toucans to try and figure out where Pico might have gone. Can the Junior Rangers bring Peyo and Pico back together again?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠幫助一隻比冰箱還重的加拉帕戈斯象龜翻身,再次腳踏實地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers help a Galapagos tortoise - which can weigh more than a fridge - flip back on its feet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彼由被困在河中央,周圍都是可怕的河怪。小遊俠能救出他嗎?這些河怪真是看上去般可怕嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo is stranded in the middle of a river, surrounded by scary river monsters. Will the Junior Rangers be able to save him? Are these river monsters as scary as they seem?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠找到一隻走失的吸血蝙蝠嬰兒。他們能找到牠的家,並把牠安全地送回家人身邊嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a lost baby vampire bat. Will they be able to find its home and return the baby bat to its family safely?

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #38
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻送子鳥和鯨頭鸛到節目做秀。牠倆都有大而實用的喙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Stork and a Shoebill to the show. Both of these animals have large and useful beaks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #39
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一匹野馬和一隻火山兔到節目做秀。牠倆都是瀕危物種,目前正被保育救助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Wild Horse and a Volcano Rabbit to the show. Each of these animals is an endangered species and is being helped through conservation efforts.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎獵豹和湯氏瞪羚來到節目。節目重點是獵食者的習性和動物的速度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Cheetah and a Thomsons Gazelle to the show. Show elements focus on predatory habits and animal speed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎海豚和果蝠來到節目。即使牠們的棲息地南轅北轍,但同樣使用迴聲定位來導航。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Dolphin and Fruit Bat to the show. Both animals use echo-location for navigation despite their very different habitats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎澳洲本土的樹熊和鴕鳥來到節目。樹熊揀飲擇食,而鴕鳥則飢不擇食!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Koala and an Ostrich, both natives of Australia, to the show. While the Koala is a fussy eater, Ostriches will eat anything!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去澳洲幫樹熊找一個家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to Australia to find a home for a koala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在ZooMoo廚房,大猩猩忍者正為甸奴準備一頓豐富的神秘晚餐。今月的菜單上有可怕的昆蟲、嚇人的螞蟻和一碟海牛糞便!你能幫甸奴猜出晚餐吃甚麼嗎?到底又有誰會想吃這些奇特的菜餚呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inside the ZooMoo kitchen, Ninja Gorilla is preparing a mystery meal for Dinos dinner. On the menu this month are gruesome grubs, awful ants and a plate of manatee poop! Can you help Dino work out Whats For Dinner -- And who on earth would want to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 閃電將一個動物檔案傳送到貓頭鷹的電腦。你能猜到那是甚麼動物嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From somewhere deep in the wilderness, intrepid photographer Flash sends Owl pictures of an amazing animal for his collection. Can you help Owl guess what extraordinary animal Flash has filmed today?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忽達作為一條年幼毛毛蟲,對作為年幼動物有著獨特的見解。透過她迷人而開朗的方式,我們從她那裡學習到其他小動物的生活。新鄰居在本月搬進樹上的巢,牠們忘記興建浴室,令事情變得一團糟!駝鹿媽媽為了保護她的孩子不受餓狼傷害而放手一搏,忽達學會如何勇敢地保護她自己的孩子—她的朱古力魚!對我們的好友忽達來說,這將
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟沙畫藝術家Sock Fong和她的ZooMoo團隊一起,只用沙子製作出令人驚嘆的藝術品!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Sand Artist Sock Fong and her ZooMoo crew as she makes amazing artwork with nothing but sand! Join our friend Sock Fong as she creates amazing animal art using sand!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧寶寶擁有世上最嘈雜的睡房。在裡面睡覺的時候,神奇的動物卻在外面發出一些非常奇怪的聲音。你能幫助奧寶寶找出是誰發出如此可怕的噪音嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Baby Orang has the worlds noisiest bedroom. Inside, its time to go to sleep -- but outside, its time for an amazing animal to make some very strange noises. Can you help Baby O discover whos making such a terrible racket?

Sleeping Baby O is woke

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小DJ正在打碟,起來跳入舞池吧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Baby DJ spins the vinyl, get off the sofa and onto the dance floor!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰在那裡?閃電剛發現了另一隻很棒的生物,他可以把牠收錄到自己的動物字母表中!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flash has just spotted another cool creature he can add to his Animal Alphabet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟阿芬娜和朋友們一起釋放藝術細胞並畫一些很酷的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Afrina and friends as they unleash their artistic ability and draw us some very cool animals!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 你能猜出這只動物吃什麼嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can you guess what does this animal eats?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to Australia to find a home for a koala.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lemur is a master of face painting. Whats that hes painting?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在ZooMoo廚房,大猩猩忍者正為甸奴準備一頓豐富的神秘晚餐。今月的菜單上有可怕的昆蟲、嚇人的螞蟻和一碟海牛糞便!你能幫甸奴猜出晚餐吃甚麼嗎?到底又有誰會想吃這些奇特的菜餚呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inside the ZooMoo kitchen, Ninja Gorilla is preparing a mystery meal for Dinos dinner. On the menu this month are gruesome grubs, awful ants and a plate of manatee poop! Can you help Dino work out Whats For Dinner -- And who on earth would want to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 閃電將一個動物檔案傳送到貓頭鷹的電腦。你能猜到那是甚麼動物嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From somewhere deep in the wilderness, intrepid photographer Flash sends Owl pictures of an amazing animal for his collection. Can you help Owl guess what extraordinary animal Flash has filmed today?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忽達作為一條年幼毛毛蟲,對作為年幼動物有著獨特的見解。透過她迷人而開朗的方式,我們從她那裡學習到其他小動物的生活。新鄰居在本月搬進樹上的巢,牠們忘記興建浴室,令事情變得一團糟!駝鹿媽媽為了保護她的孩子不受餓狼傷害而放手一搏,忽達學會如何勇敢地保護她自己的孩子—她的朱古力魚!對我們的好友忽達來說,這將
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟沙畫藝術家Sock Fong和她的ZooMoo團隊一起,只用沙子製作出令人驚嘆的藝術品!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Sand Artist Sock Fong and her ZooMoo crew as she makes amazing artwork with nothing but sand! Join our friend Sock Fong as she creates amazing animal art using sand!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧寶寶擁有世上最嘈雜的睡房。在裡面睡覺的時候,神奇的動物卻在外面發出一些非常奇怪的聲音。你能幫助奧寶寶找出是誰發出如此可怕的噪音嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Baby Orang has the worlds noisiest bedroom. Inside, its time to go to sleep -- but outside, its time for an amazing animal to make some very strange noises. Can you help Baby O discover whos making such a terrible racket?

Sleeping Baby O is woke

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在ZooMoo廚房,大猩猩忍者正為甸奴準備一頓豐富的神秘晚餐。今月的菜單上有可怕的昆蟲、嚇人的螞蟻和一碟海牛糞便!你能幫甸奴猜出晚餐吃甚麼嗎?到底又有誰會想吃這些奇特的菜餚呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inside the ZooMoo kitchen, Ninja Gorilla is preparing a mystery meal for Dinos dinner. On the menu this month are gruesome grubs, awful ants and a plate of manatee poop! Can you help Dino work out Whats For Dinner -- And who on earth would want to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 閃電將一個動物檔案傳送到貓頭鷹的電腦。你能猜到那是甚麼動物嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From somewhere deep in the wilderness, intrepid photographer Flash sends Owl pictures of an amazing animal for his collection. Can you help Owl guess what extraordinary animal Flash has filmed today?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忽達作為一條年幼毛毛蟲,對作為年幼動物有著獨特的見解。透過她迷人而開朗的方式,我們從她那裡學習到其他小動物的生活。新鄰居在本月搬進樹上的巢,牠們忘記興建浴室,令事情變得一團糟!駝鹿媽媽為了保護她的孩子不受餓狼傷害而放手一搏,忽達學會如何勇敢地保護她自己的孩子—她的朱古力魚!對我們的好友忽達來說,這將
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flutter loves to watch babies growing up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟沙畫藝術家Sock Fong和她的ZooMoo團隊一起,只用沙子製作出令人驚嘆的藝術品!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Sand Artist Sock Fong and her ZooMoo crew as she makes amazing artwork with nothing but sand! Join our friend Sock Fong as she creates amazing animal art using sand!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧寶寶擁有世上最嘈雜的睡房。在裡面睡覺的時候,神奇的動物卻在外面發出一些非常奇怪的聲音。你能幫助奧寶寶找出是誰發出如此可怕的噪音嗎?

Baby Orang has the worlds noisiest bedroom. Inside, its time to go to sleep -- but outside, its time for an amazing animal to make some very strange noises. Can you help Baby O discover whos making such a terrible racket?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴倒數最快的五種動物。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴盤點動物王國中排名前五的吸盤。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five suckers in the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟比利兔合唱,他在晚餐前學到很多新歌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sing along with Billy Bunny as he learns lots of new songs before dinnertime!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生把噴嚏打到鑿奇身上,並把自己一部分魔力轉移給他,到底之後會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Mr. Garden Gnome sneezes onto Chalky and transfers some of his magical powers to him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯芬克斯叔叔、商人先生和阿米爾之間因溝通不當而鬧出不快。孩子們必須弄清楚發生甚麼事,並幫每個人解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s a miscommunication between Uncle Sphinx, Mr. Merchant and Aamil that causes some unhappiness. The children have to figure out what happened and help straighten things out with each person.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數隻遷徙的螃蟹霸了沉船作為新家園,令紅鬍子十分沮喪。 小孩們必須幫紅鬍子和莫里斯趕走牠們。他們會怎樣做?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Several migrating crabs claim the Shipwreck as their new home, much to Redbeards dismay. The children have to help Redbeard and Maurice chase them away. How will they do it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊戲室的燈熄滅了。伸手不見五指很是可怕,但小孩們知道一根有著永恆之光的蠟燭!要取得它的話,他們必須面對恐懼,並進入前所未見最黑暗的洞穴!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lights in the playroom go out. Being in the dark is scary, but the children learn about a candle with an everlasting light! To retrieve it, they have to face their fears and enter the darkest cave ever!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拔迪先生似乎總是很暴躁。小孩們想出一個讓拔迪先生眉開眼笑的計劃,但卻事與願違。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Buddy always seems to be very cranky. The children come up with a plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫里斯不小心把紅鬍子的鐵鈎弄彎了。小孩們幫紅鬍子找到一些相當獨特的代鈎,但紅鬍子懷疑它們有多實用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Maurice accidentally bends Redbeards hook out of shape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生找到一張地圖,上面有通往獎勵密室的線索,但他毫無頭緒。小孩們渴望幫探險家先生破解線索,並找出密室裡有甚麼獎勵等待著他們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Explorer finds a map with clues leading to a secret chamber of rewards.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們在金銀島尋找黃金茉莉花。不過紅鬍子船長打算先下手為強!他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children go in search of the Golden Jasmine Flower on Treasure Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和花園侏儒結交一位外表非常獨特的新朋友。他們努力尋找可以一起玩的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and garden gnomes make a new friend with a very unique appearance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩隊超級英雄隊伍爭奪成為遠東唯一的超英隊伍。誰能贏出?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two superhero teams compete to be the one and only superhero team of the Far East. Who will win?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小豬和熊貓大吵了一場。他們各自舉行試鏡來尋找取代對方的人。他們會選誰成為他們的新「兄弟」?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pig and Panda are in a huge fight. They hold separate auditions to find a replacement for each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和龍先生一起創造一個宏大又刺激的故事。每個孩子都將自己的創作力量同幻想加插到編造的故事中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Mr. Dragon create one big, exciting story together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哪怕只有一天,咩利希望他有真正的腳。花園侏儒先生幫他夢想成真。他非常喜歡新腳,不想放棄它……永遠都擁有它們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Merry wishes he had real legs, even just for a day. Mr. Garden Gnome makes it happen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牛牛雛菊很難過。小孩們會做甚麼令她高興?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daisy the cow is really sad. What will the children do to cheer her up?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿斯翠邀請小孩們到太空船玩。他們在玩樂途中開始感到不適。甚麼能令他們好轉?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空員先生遇上麻煩!小孩們必須拯救阿斯翠的父親,並幫他完成任務。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛發現城堡裡的所有玩具都放在一個盒子裡,他們面對著一項幾乎不可能完成的任務。雖然誘惑很大,但他們接到嚴格的命令,不能碰盒子,因為他們肯定會弄得一團糟。他們能服從命令,讓城堡一塵不染嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello andy Goomo are faced with an almost impossible task when they discover that all the toys in the castle have been placed in a single box. The temptation is great but they have strict orders not to touch the box for they would surely make a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 還有比在音樂誕生的星球更適合跳舞的地方嗎?啫堡上的每個人都會向您展示一段舞蹈,這樣我們就可以隨著啫堡的節奏一起跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Is there a better place to dance than the planet where music is born? Every person on Jammbo has a dance to show you so we can all dance together to the rhythm of Jammbo.

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #1

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a python in a very unusal place.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a Pangolin stuck in the middle of an extremely dangerous situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can the Junior Rangers locate the otter pup family within the dense concrete jungle of Singapore?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Flash, Lemur, Afrina and friends on ZooMoo to play our fun game show, Guess The Animal! Our teams of contestants are given three clues to guess the animal. Play Guess The Animal! with our ZooMoo friends and learn more about our animal friend

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是一些非常奇怪的動物,我們認為它們可能來自外太空。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are so strange so weird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討喜歡旅行的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores animals that like to travel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅裡很想跳舞,因為這一集都是關於動物的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rory is in the mood for dancing because this episode is all about animal’s feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是世界上最大的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the biggest animals in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有很多五顏六色的動物……但有些奇妙的動物只有兩種顏色!對,今天的測驗全都關於黑白動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals that are Black and White!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人愛釣魚,但絕對敵不過野外高手!今天的測驗是關於那些同樣喜歡釣魚的奇妙動物!!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals that like to go fishing!!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人們在幾千年來一直建造令人驚嘆的建築……但有些動物更早就建造出瘋狂建築!今天的測驗是關於出色的動物建築師!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ttodays quiz is all about Brilliant Builders!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從前,人們在戰鬥時常常穿著盔甲來保護自己。許多動物仍然這樣做,這就是為何今天的測驗關於神奇裝甲動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Today’s quiz is all about Amazing Armoured Animals!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #9
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一輛魯莽的汽車導致樹頂橋倒塌,一隻稀有的小猴子與家人失散。小遊俠必須盡快找到一家團聚的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a reckless car causes a treetop bridge to collapse, a young rare monkey is separated from its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #10
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉認為她發現了一條可以瞬移的蛇,但原來這條蛇還有另一種有趣的能力。小遊俠使用它的特殊技能將其轉移到安全地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari thinks that she has spotted a snake that can teleport.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #11
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩莉在一個廢棄的魚缸裡發現了一條彈塗魚,誤將它放生到海裡!小遊俠必須爭分奪秒,拯救彈塗魚,並將其帶回紅樹林。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari finds a mudskipper in an abandoned fish tank and releases it into the sea by mistake!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 #12
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition #12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿佳需要遊俠的幫助,因為他的大綠葉鵯朋友完全拒絕唱歌。小遊俠開始尋找完美的鳴禽來完成葉鵯的二重唱願望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai needs the rangers help when his Greater Green Leafbird friend absolutely refuses to sing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是中國以及您在那裡發現的奇妙獨特的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about China and the marvellous unique animals that you find there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物進食的不同方式。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the different ways that animals eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集我們將看看所有那些看起來很可愛但絕對不可愛的大型美麗動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode we’re taking a look at all those big beautiful animals that look cute but are definitely not cuddly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的都是動物,它們是我們最好的朋友、我們的幫手、我們的同伴和我們的夥伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are our best friends our helpers our companions and our sidekicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人為了讓他們的寵物更好看而十分努力!但野外的情況卻大相逕庭!奇妙的動物在沒有任何幫助下炫耀自己的東西,今天的測驗就是關於這些超級炫耀狂的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Today’s quiz is all about the Super Show Offs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想看看世上正發生甚麼事時—我們用的是眼睛!但我們的眼睛絕對比不上某些動物的奇特視力!這就是為何今天的測驗全都關於優秀的眼球!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with Excellent Eyeballs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有些動物顏色鮮豔,很容易被看到。但今集我們要看的是喜歡匿藏的動物,這就是為何這個測驗全都關於偽裝大師!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Masters of Disguise!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的腳幫助我們到達想去的地方。但動物可以用它們做出各種各樣的事。今天的測驗是關於神奇的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Fantastic Feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有關世界各地動物的最新新聞,請收聽 ZooMoo News!在我們的朋友 Emiko 的主持下,ZooMoo 的巡迴記者團隊來到現場,讓我們了解重要的動物問題,並為我們帶來最新的天氣預報。因此,如果您想了解所有熱門話題的所有信息,請關注 ZooMoo 新聞 – 僅限 ZooMoo!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the latest news about animals from all around the world, tune in to ZooMoo News! Hosted by our friend Emiko, ZooMoos team of roving reporters are out on location, keeping us up-to-date with important animal issues and bringing us the latest in w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇家花園中的女王之歌果實被盜。偵探二人組啫堡俠和拍檔俠需要破案。每個人都是疑犯。他們的聆聽技巧和團隊合作幫助他們抓住水果賊。這真是一個驚喜—即使對小偷亦然。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen’s Song Fruit are being stolen from the royal garden.It’s up to the detective duo of Jammboman and Sidekickman to solve this crime. Everyone is a suspect. Their listening skills and teamwork help them catch the fruit filcher. It’s quite a su

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩學會尊重並善待植物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns to respect and treat the plants well.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在洗澡時與小豬一起放聲歌唱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Let your vocals soar with Piglet while taking a bath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曲奇製作的壽司非常逼真,令你想吃掉它,並穿著她的巨型機器人服裝跳舞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kooki makes sushi so real you will want to eat it and busts out some moves in her giant robot costume.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是曲奇的派對時間,她製作怪獸派對裝飾和超棒的生日蛋糕服裝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its party time with Kooki as she makes monster party poppers and an awesome birthday cake costume.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧寶寶擁有世上最嘈雜的睡房。在裡面睡覺的時候,神奇的動物卻在外面發出一些非常奇怪的聲音。你能幫助奧寶寶找出是誰發出如此可怕的噪音嗎?

Baby Orang has the worlds noisiest bedroom. Inside, its time to go to sleep -- but outside, its time for an amazing animal to make some very strange noises. Can you help Baby O discover whos making such a terrible racket?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its peek-a-boo time with Kooki, as she makes a puppy card and she whips up a rocket ship you can eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的腳幫助我們到達想去的地方。但動物可以用它們做出各種各樣的事。今天的測驗是關於神奇的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Fantastic Feet!

epg.programme_title_en: Hero and the Beauty, The Pt.II
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）傅天麟與甄秋水帶朱痕鐵劍找到師叔丹心劍客。逍遙子等人搶去劍，將麟打下山崖，幸大難不死。心自揭身份原來他是水的師父。大戰中，邪派高手挾持水，指她乃明朝遺裔瓊花公主，香師父突然倒戈，將敗局扭轉。
張小桃懷有蘇雪樓骨肉，卻被樓兄雪天誘騙嫁予他人；樓誤會桃負情，娶歌女白影梅。樓婚後沉迷醉鄉，更因索錢不遂打梅，梅欲輕生，被桃阻止。樓以為梅已死，狂風暴雨下吊祭梅，桃、梅尋至，三人坦誠相對，樓重新振作。

金蝴蝶莊靜嫻自嫁給雷紹文後，金盆洗手。水災來襲，金蝴蝶盜取傅不仁等富豪之錢財救災，更去信勒索錢如命。文父雷翼鵬懷疑嫻重出江湖，著文暗中監視，卻被嫻發現；嫻為保清白，決意捉拿冒充金蝴蝶之人。嫻發現世叔之女宋美娥仰慕她正義之舉，故假扮金蝴蝶劫富濟貧，嫻成功勸服娥不再犯案。可是再有假金蝴蝶多番作案，倡狂如盜賊，嫻遂與娥聯手追查可疑人物，同時鵬邀嫻父莊德明同往緝拿犯人。幾經波折，眾人終將犯罪集團一網打盡。

epg.programme_title_en: Story of Tin Ngai Fong Cho, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵荒馬亂，柳天涯與梁芳草約定戰後共諧連理。程雨庭長子早逝，庭逼草入門為媳。戰事結束，涯得知草被逼冥婚一事，於是伺機混入程家。庭為草立貞節牌匾，草與涯在鄉民們前控訴庭，庭眼見群情洶湧，終醒悟，成全二人。
杜員外之女文卿與書生程雁秋一見鍾情，杜員外為免卿被迫嫁知縣之子陳貴，派家僕邀秋到府議婚，家僕卻誤請來秋之學生何大虎，卿遂以婢女代嫁。貴得知卿未嫁，到杜家搶人，秋施計使虎之妹愛靚嫁給貴，自己則與卿成親。

金蝴蝶莊靜嫻自嫁給雷紹文後，金盆洗手。水災來襲，金蝴蝶盜取傅不仁等富豪之錢財救災，更去信勒索錢如命。文父雷翼鵬懷疑嫻重出江湖，著文暗中監視，卻被嫻發現；嫻為保清白，決意捉拿冒充金蝴蝶之人。嫻發現世叔之女宋美娥仰慕她正義之舉，故假扮金蝴蝶劫富濟貧，嫻成功勸服娥不再犯案。可是再有假金蝴蝶多番作案，倡狂如盜賊，嫻遂與娥聯手追查可疑人物，同時鵬邀嫻父莊德明同往緝拿犯人。幾經波折，眾人終將犯罪集團一網打盡。
張小桃懷有蘇雪樓骨肉，卻被樓兄雪天誘騙嫁予他人；樓誤會桃負情，娶歌女白影梅。樓婚後沉迷醉鄉，更因索錢不遂打梅，梅欲輕生，被桃阻止。樓以為梅已死，狂風暴雨下吊祭梅，桃、梅尋至，三人坦誠相對，樓重新振作。

游擊隊隊員丁紹元混入戲班收集情報，與梅羅香日久生情。縣長垂涎香美色，邀香到其家中暫住。元發現縣長夫人竟是其初戀情人白娟，並得娟暗中幫忙。游擊隊計劃殺參謀長，香甘願做內應，元不捨，故娟捨身助元完成任務。
周日青奉命尋訪十四皇叔及聯絡武林十三劍，調解朝廷與武林仇怨，途中遇司馬長纓及王雪蓮。纓誤殺金羅漢徒弟，漢要與纓比武，其徒西鳳喜歡纓暗助他。青、纓尋得叔並悉鳳為其女後，鳳謊稱與纓發生關係，令蓮出走墮崖。
大粒墨嫁孤寒財後無子出，讓夫娶婢女辣撻妹。妹誕下阿珍及阿寶後，被墨迫她自盡，幸得婢女秋香所救。寶長大高中狀元公審妹，香道出真相，母子相認，惜妹吐血身亡。珍、寶要墨向妹棺木下跪認錯，然後將母親風光大葬。
陳火被四眼張陷害入獄，出獄前夕，火妻病逝，臨終前託杜仲文照顧子女阿蘭及洪仔。火出獄後不敢與子女相認，但對他們照顧有加。洪患急症，蘭為醫藥費及還債賣身，火為救子女，助張行竊，後雖與子女相認，卻難逃法網。

霍達劫貪官鏢銀失敗，後鏢銀卻被鬼俠劫走，並殺死鏢師。鏢師好友仇平誤以為是霍達所為，雙方發生打鬥。達子霍詩傳無意中發現家中婢女馬玉蘭竟是鬼俠，玉蘭道出原委，並告知詩傳父親是明臣史可法，霍達是其殺父仇人。霍達、仇平等應鬼俠之約來到斷魂谷，出現的鬼俠卻是玉蘭母親苗金鳳所假扮，她不敵被捉。詩傳往質問霍達其身世，霍達道出真相，並與詩傳、玉蘭往救金鳳。成功救人後，眾人決定恢復國土大計，還撮合詩傳與玉蘭的婚事。

epg.programme_title_en: Adventure at the Riverside of Lay Kian (Pt.1)

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李子雲遭伙記阿讒襲擊搶去財物，因而失憶，幸得婢女蕭月梅救濟並結成夫婦，婚後更育有一女。雲出外打工意外受傷，恢復記憶卻忘記妻女，梅母女遂尋雲至李家，雲拒相認，梅傷心不已。雲舊地重遊勾起記憶，終一家團聚。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富翁陳少珊於別墅被殺，王探長調查時發現兒子王稼聲與懷疑涉案歌女黃曼娜關係密切。律師到別墅宣讀遺囑被殺，遺產繼承人陳文英則遭花王脅持，被探長碰見。花王說出幕後主腦；聲怒殺設局謀害自己的人，最終難逃法網。
盲人算命師吳保當年被狀師關澤誣告而入獄，懷恨在心，他伺機戲弄其子仁樹。樹偶然認識保的女兒美珠，互生情愫，卻不知對方身份，因而報復作弄保。保得悉樹、珠相戀，拒絕二人婚事。樹惟有達成保的願望，才得美人歸。
陸湘卿與李安寧婚後誕下兒子李天成，卿舊愛呂淮良突然造訪，李母以為兩人有染，將有孕的卿趕走，只許她每年中秋見成一次。卿誕下女兒陸月梅，梅長大後竟與成相戀，卿極力阻止。後梅、成得知彼此關係，與卿一家團圓。
田大雄與余海燕拜於蔡李佛門下，兩人為救蘇菲，與余劍豪結下樑子。原來豪是燕的繼父，他派燕拜於蔡李佛門下，是想套出此門的拳術。雄被豪綁走，燕不值其父所為，通知眾人趕往救雄。雄與燕的師父終打敗豪，並救回雄。

楊月樓在文守廉府重遇舊戀人范冰凝，並納為妾。楊道忙潛入月房內偷竊被發現，刺斃了月。凝被嫁禍殺夫，被判終身監禁；凝於牢房產下小樓，廉帶著小樓逃亡。小樓長大高中狀元為母翻案，使計讓忙供出真相，凝沉冤得雪。
白玫瑰瞞著女兒當交際花，得杜壽齡照顧，被女兒老師張明發現。玫瑰患病，明每天問候，二人結為夫婦。齡從中作梗，明被辭退，明母要玫瑰離開明。玫瑰重操故業，在齡威迫下訛稱對明心死。玫瑰舊病復發望見明最後一面。
賀天龍與好友蘇人傑被魏嵬挑撥離間而大打出手，嵬更從旁暗殺龍，嫁禍於傑。龍女芝蘭的師兄旭東竟是傑之子，龍妻要蘭往報仇，幸傑查出龍的死因，並傳授蘭七煞掌。蘭偷偷與東找嵬報仇失敗，傑出手相助，蘭終手刃仇人。
龍王三公主龍蕙蘭化身為人，對鏢師李劍雲一見傾心，雲卻與表妹葉素心相戀並私訂終生。蘭施計逼雲跟她成婚，心誤會雲棄愛而向閻王告狀，此事最終被玉帝知悉，玉帝要懲治蘭與龍王。蘭知錯而甘願受罰，雲與心終可成親。
王良、王超、王絡合租一單位，鄰居施秀霞鍾情良，可是良用情不專，更與超、絡出言侮辱霞，於是霞與同事后英使計戲弄三「王」，但最終事情敗露。三人質問霞，霞怒斥三人。良悔不當初，與霞重修舊好，有人情終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: When a Lovely Girl Bestows Her
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 辛鳳英一家在梁百芬的公司工作，二人偶遇，英及家人不知芬是其老闆，向芬訴苦。英誤以為芬生活捉襟見肘，為他安排工作，芬決定「微服出巡」。芬得悉公司種種問題，即提出改革，並向英及其家人表明身分後，向英求婚。
高慧珠偕母尋親不果，珠母暈倒，幸得周祥福收留二人。富家子黃德昌偶然認識了珠，二人漸生情愫，卻遭昌父阻止。珠母找到已成銀行董事長的丈夫並團聚，時昌父母來借錢，珠趁機戲弄二人，昌父母道歉，珠、昌終成眷屬。
黑幫厲以彪的珠寶疑遭顧大強搶去，彪找金震宇合作把珠寶奪回。期間，宇發現神秘女子金鷗也在追尋珠寶，兩人協議合作。後宇知悉彪設局要他與強互相殘殺，故他與鷗、強對付彪，而珠寶原屬鷗亡兄擁有，宇無奈讓鷗拿回。
阿蘭被叔叔賣到妓院，獲倒水材救出，並得盲炳及胡老伯收留。原來胡是退隱的潭腿高手，炳獲其傳授六路潭腿。此時蘭被抓回妓院，更遭打死。炳往救蘭，遇高手豬肉貴，炳不敵，幸胡傳授餘下潭腿功夫予炳，終成功打敗貴。

劉家兄弟君上、君瑞兄友弟恭，劉母將家傳紫霞杯交由瑞妻張英保管，上妻金清妒火中燒。清受婢女榮春教唆，趁上、瑞上京營商及赴考，偷取紫霞杯及誣陷英不貞，英被趕離家。多年後幸瑞高中回來，終查明真相並將清懲治。
汪永祥與林慶雖生活貧困，一張床位二人同睡，但見孤兒安仔身世可憐，收養了他。同屋吳不化對包租公三叔的女兒小鳳心懷不軌，離間鳳與祥感情，幸得安仔向鳳解釋。祥獲聘為工程師，三叔要化遷出把房讓給鳳、祥作新房。
張婉薇與關德文被父親安排婚事，但兩人不願盲婚啞嫁拒見對方。其後薇和文意外相遇，兩人一見鍾情，卻不知彼此身分，於是各自找好友王玉玲和李斌代相親，卻讓玲、斌產生誤會。文終發現薇身分，故不再反對父親的安排。
殷向榮的繼室王丹妮與情人麥深計劃奪產，故陷害榮子可祺入獄，又誣陷可妻江雪貞與可弟兆祺有染。兆含冤，憤而離家，後成為探員並揭發妮與深的陰謀。然而，可對貞誤會甚深，他竟越獄欲殺貞，幸真相大白，一家人冰釋。

殷向榮的繼室王丹妮與情人麥深計劃奪產，故陷害榮子可祺入獄，又誣陷可妻江雪貞與可弟兆祺有染。兆含冤，憤而離家，後成為探員並揭發妮與深的陰謀。然而，可對貞誤會甚深，他竟越獄欲殺貞，幸真相大白，一家人冰釋。

A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸淩同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸淩,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into partici

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高氏五兄弟,少時家遭巨變,流離失散。長大後,各有際遇,不知殺父仇人就是無惡不作的騰龍莊主。但五兄弟各自均不滿騰龍莊欺淩弱小之所作所為,並誓要除魔。當五兄弟重逢後,他們一起努力練功,準備與騰龍莊莊主及其幫會一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楚留香與八王爺設下計謀,佯裝行刺失敗,趁機潛入「幽靈山莊」作臥底,意圖將這座罪惡巢穴一舉殲滅。山莊內聚集了江湖上惡貫滿盈的亡命之徒,且傳言時有鬼魅出沒。楚留香在查探過程中,逐漸陷入一連串懸疑詭祕的事件之中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泉州才子陳伯卿,邂逅潮州第一美人黃碧琚,心生傾慕;後伯卿得知兩人幼時曾定親,於是隱瞞身份,賣身黃府,作陪讀書僮,以接近碧琚。陝西巡撫之子林大雄,垂涎碧琚美色,強自下聘,欲娶之為妻;碧琚父貪財怕勢,不理家人反對,收下林家聘禮。伯卿得知碧琚已有婚配,刺激過度,一病不起…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通天少爺李寶通乃棉胎店老闆李昌建之獨子,平素不服父親管教外,還經常整蠱作怪;古板嚴謹的李昌建,屢遭兒子作弄亦不自知。寶通經常暗中替喬裝乞丐的偵緝隊長陳英剛買食物,並向他學習武功;後英剛給「紅槍客」林飛殺死,寶通正好在暗處看見事發經過,並偷聽到林飛所透露的犯案者名字。此時,寶通行蹤被發現,幸寶通機智,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao’s chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情描述楊過逃離全真教,誤打誤撞與小龍女相遇。二人在古墓生活,本為融洽;後小龍女為師姐李莫愁所傷,更遭尹志平迷姦。小龍女誤以為失身於楊過,遂提婚議,楊過不知就裡加以婉拒,小龍女悲憤離開古墓。楊過四出訪尋,終與小龍女重逢;惟重提婚事,卻為黃蓉勸阻。小龍女為不讓師徒戀損楊過聲譽,悄然出走...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝康王被困於金營巨宅,四周被武林高手嚴密看守。兩名身懷絕技的義士必須克服重重困難,完成看似不可能的任務,設法救出康王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin strongh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 包公發現劉妃在二十年前為保其位而謀害李妃,將李妃剛誕下的兒子調走後,把她逐出皇宮。於是,包公用妙計誘大太監郭槐認罪,揭發當年他與劉妃合謀陷害李妃之奸計,並將劉妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宮,與已為皇帝的兒子團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li’s new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her ac

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 根據中國古典文學巨著紅樓夢改編。賈寶玉出身京城中的名門望族賈府,與表妹林黛玉彼此相戀。可惜他們的戀情為賈母所不容,更使計瞞騙寶玉另娶一富家女,結果令寶玉和黛玉這對金童玉女落入悲慘的下場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋太祖趙匡胤之弟光義恃建國有功,囂張跋扈,逼殺南唐後主李煜,李之舊部李浪矢誓報仇。太傅陳搏因欲修煉成仙,必先得皇帝封誥,故與光義妥協,助其奪取帝位,事成後由光義祭天封為華山神仙。陳搏帶光義夜闖禁宮,弒兄自立,並殺死李浪等心腹大患...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節,故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命,後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活,哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江小魚在父母被殺後,與孿生兄弟花無缺失散。自小被帶往惡人谷,並由一班惡人谷谷主共同撫養成人的江小魚,長大後決定離開惡人谷,出外闖蘯江湖。他最後可否成功為父母報仇,又能否再遇孿生兄弟花無缺?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述女俠俞飛霞,被武林盟主誤會她是运用「黑沙掌」,偷去神功寶書的幪面少女。於是她女扮男裝,混入少林寺暗中查探真相...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid roma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇燦是酒莊老闆的長子,生性瀟灑不羈,在被學校開除後,被迫接受家中安排的私人教師指導。沒想到這位教師竟是一位身懷絕技的武術大師,蘇燦因此拜入其門下,展開嚴格的修煉。然而,當家人與師父慘遭冷血悍匪「蜈蚣」殺害後,蘇燦踏上了一場生死難料的復仇之路。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 昆汀・塔倫提諾第八部作品,背景設定於寒冷的懷俄明州,八名陌生人——包括兩名賞金獵人與一名通緝犯——在暴風雪中被迫聚在一起,對抗天候,也彼此對立。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一場前所未有的全球大流行疾病蹂躪地球後,資源變得極其匱乏,甚至必須以命相換。一位母親為了救活病重的女兒,不惜拼死一搏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mother fights to save the life of her ailing daughter after an unprecedented pandemic ravaged the planet, leaving resources so scarce you must pay for them with your life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憤世嫉俗的員工奧森厭惡他那些懶惰的同事。他發現了一間秘密的、神奇的辦公室,這間辦公室能顯著提升他的工作效率和地位,但他的同事們卻看不到這間辦公室,並因此對他的成功心生嫉妒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《回到未來 III》中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士。這部影片充滿了笑話、動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, it’s the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在《魔鬼孩子王》中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子。這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作、幽默和感人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當暴徒襲擊前刺客約翰·維克(基努·李維 飾)時,他們完全不知道自己招惹了一位黑道傳奇。維克將紐約市變成彈痕累累的戰場,展開一場毫不留情的追殺與復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When thugs attack ex-assassin John Wick (Keanu Reeves), they have no idea theyve unleashed an underworld legend. Turning NYC into a bullet-riddled playground, Wick embarks on a merciless rampage to hunt down his adversaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的《神鬼認證:傑森包恩》也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集。伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德、文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方世玉加入紅花會革命,誓要推翻滿清、復興明朝。在高飛武打與森嚴禮教之下,這位傳奇英雄還得面對私生活的混亂——同時背負兩位準妻的壓力!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fong Sai Yuk joins the Red Flower revolution to topple the Manchus and restore the Ming. Amidst high-flying martial arts and rigid society demands, the legendary hero must also manage the chaos of his personal life, saddled with two presumptive wives

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧斯卡金像獎®提名者西爾維斯特史泰龍主演的這部動作驚悚片,將帶您體驗腎上腺素飆升的快感,直到最後一格震撼人心的畫面!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《恐怖角》中,勞勃・狄尼洛飾演一名心懷怨恨的前科犯,對其昔日律師(尼克・諾特飾)展開步步進逼的跟蹤報復。由馬丁・史柯西斯執導,這部充滿張力的驚悚片是令人不寒而慄的經典重拍之作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Cape Fear, Robert De Niro plays a vengeful ex-con stalking his former lawyer, played by Nick Nolte. Directed by Martin Scorsese, this suspense-filled thriller is a chilling classic remake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一部風格獨特、跨越文化的義大利式西部片。講述一名法外之徒與一名冷酷的武士被迫在美國西南部聯手,追捕一名偷走欲獻給美國總統之無價禮儀寶劍的狡猾強盜首領。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique cross-cultural Spaghetti Western where an outlaw and a stoic samurai are forced to team up in the American Southwest to track down a smooth bandit leader who stole a priceless ceremonial sword intended for the US President.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A small-town crime boss accepts delivery of a stolen car, only to find there's a baby in the back-seat. He and his transgender wife cut out the boy's tongue and raise him as a mute accomplice in their crimes. When the grown "Sonny Boy" escapes and tries to make contact with the outside world, the attention he draws to his warped family results in darkly-humored mayhem.
