epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A young woman struggling with a sordid past finds that her biggest enemy had larger demons than she did.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young woman struggling with a sordid past finds that her biggest enemy had larger demons than she did.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A frightening doomsday drama about an alien organism with the potential to destroy all living things.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A frightening doomsday drama about an alien organism with the potential to destroy all living things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張騫奉漢武帝之命率領百餘人組成使團出使大月氏,中途卻遭匈奴截殺及俘虜。張及部份生還的使團成員淪為階下囚,被軟禁十年之久,原本要實行密謀多年的逃跑計畫也被突如其來的一場匈奴與大漢將軍的戰爭打破。儘管如此..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Appointed by the Emperor Han, Zhang leads a diplomatic mission to Greater Rouzhi, but they are either killed or captured by the Huns on the way. Zhang and the captives are imprisoned for 10 years and the battle between the Huns and Han destroyed their long-awaited escape plan. Zhang vows to overcome the trials and bring the captives back to Han.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 徐震從昏迷中驚醒時,發覺身處在封閉的鐵箱之中,跟著一陣聲響後,鐵箱自動打開。他走出鐵箱,見到一片熱帶叢林,還發現林依娜及其他倖存者,眾人都來自不同國家,然而如何被運到這裡全然不知。大家在叢林中不但要面..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu finds himself trapped inside an iron box after awaking from a coma. As the box opens, he finds himself in a tropical forest together with other survivors, all not knowing how they ended up there. Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真無邪的少女清澄,為了給家人報仇,被訓練成冷血殺手。數度殺人後,她決定放下怨念,在安樂寨度過平靜的餘生,也在那裡結識了樂於助人的阿邦,與他結了婚。正當清澄隱藏武功平淡過活時,江湖風雲無奈又起。為了維..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃河邊的一個小村落,有一口浮棺出現後,村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探,但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現,千年巨蛇亦浮出水面,趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒,壽命很短,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A floating coffin triggers a series of disasters in the village and only a member of the Zhao family survives. Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐族女君九尾不幸落入梅山七怪老大猿猴精袁洪之手,陰差陽錯被姜子牙所救,卻被姜斬斷一條尾巴。九尾走投無路在女媧娘娘的指點下附身在冀州候蘇護的女兒蘇妲己身上。不久,紂王攻打冀州,妲己被俘,及後紂王娶了妲己..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nine-tailed Fox is caught by the seven monkey monster in Mount Mei. Jiang Zi Ya inadvertently saves Nine-tailed Fox but cuts off one of her tails, making her so desperate that she possesses the body of Da Ji. Shortly after, Emperor Shang invades Ji Zhou and kidnaps Da Ji, who later becomes Empress Shang and causes chaos throughout the realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境,花木蘭為老父出征,女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵,屢建戰功,取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際,敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中,趁亂攻城,令他們受到重創。為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重案組臥底警員山哥向高級督察唯Sir發送線報,说大毒梟金先生將會親自主持一宗涉及金額達二千萬美元的毒品交易。其實這是個為了找出誰是臥底而設計的陷阱,山哥身份暴露後被黑幫追殺,而其臥底身份也突然被警方刪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐門有一秘寶“洞天儀,可以提前預知惡人名錄。唐門會在此人作惡之前將其殺掉來維護天下太平。一天,唐門掌門唐無煙之名竟也出現於洞天儀之上,無煙被迫逃走,遇到善良小賊楚晨。在其幫助下,她決心殺回唐門尋找真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

During his fight with the Fox Demon who has possessed his masters body, Liu Yi Ze must defeat the Fox Demon without hurting his master. Can he vanquish the demon and safeguard everyone?

Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店,但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝,引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後,杜到天台勸女兒回家,父女兩突然被宇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Honest hairstylist Du Chang Rong, raises his daughter on his own and hopes that she will take over his salon. However his daughter dreams of becoming an artiste. In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Taoist prophecy foretells that the rise of Hei Jiao will threaten the world. As Scholar Lu Dongbin is on his way to end his marriage engagement to Bai, he finds her father missing and Bai possessed. As Lu learns about his immortal identity, he realizes that the encounter with Bai and the incidents that happened are all part of his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of criminals joins the Disciple gang to engage in drug trafficking, smuggling and assault in Pu Guang City. One day, the police receives information from an undercover of the gang, and Inspector Tang is assigned to lead a thorough investigation. They must disintegrate the gang in 72 hours for the peace and harmony of Pu Guang City.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

Zhou spoils Da Ji by building a tower to heaven against Gods will, and even oppresses his people. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1928年的上海灘,新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突,雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺周放,因父親被殺要為父報仇,帶領眾人對決龍德商會,卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.programme_title_tc: 龍棺古墓: 西夏狼王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀10年代初,以劉錦州為首的“生旦淨醜四位戲子,為了營救在西夏狼王墓失蹤的恩師袁震,不得不踏上兇險萬分的探墓尋人之旅。在墓穴中一行人經歷了種種危機和生離死別,在過程中發現了古墓的神秘寶物及師父不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early 1910s, four performers embark on a perilous journey to an ancient tomb in search of their missing master. Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城裡驚現“僵屍病毒,人心惶惶,民不聊生。茅山弟子雲淩與三位師兄弟奉命下山盡辦法解救百姓於水火,不料四人卻步入幕後黑手的陷阱,被幻蠱術迷惑,挑撥四人之間的兄弟情。及後城中更有一只壯如怪獸的食人鬼蛛入侵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..

Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對綁匪誤將刑警丁偉女友,蘇雅婷綁架。本來是一場精心設計的綁架事件,卻陰差陽錯鬧出驚天命案。丁偉錯失摯愛,決心抓住兇手,千里追兇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Ding Weis girlfriend, Su Ya Ting, is mistakenly kidnapped. The plot takes a dark turn when she is brutally murdered. Devastated by the loss, Ding dedicates himself to the task of capturing the murderer, putting in relentless efforts to seek justice for his beloved.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境,花木蘭為老父出征,女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵,屢建戰功,取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際,敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中,趁亂攻城,令他們受到重創。為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝末年,大明水師軍官林嘯為了阻止東瀛倭寇得到“神機武庫,及要找回失蹤的戰友陸老大,而接受了水師參將向吉的徵召,踏上兇險的尋寶之路。航行中,神秘海怪族羣與倭寇均同時盯上了林的船。他必須與同伴合力與倭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 胡八一與王胖子及大金牙在古蘭郡遇到Shirley楊,得知孫教授被困於龍嶺迷窟。四人一起進入迷窟尋找教授,出來後胡和王身上長出眼球狀的紅斑,根據Shirley外公的筆記,解藥雮塵珠有可能藏在黑水城的通天..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three friends meet Shirley in Gu Lan County. They save a professor trapped in the Dragon Labyrinth, but two friends suffer from skin rashes after leaving the labyrinth. According to the notes written by Shirleys grandfather, the antidotes may be hidden at Tong Tian Buddhist Temple, so the four of them set off on a challenging journey for the cure.

epg.programme_title_en: Fengshen the Fall of King Zhou
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女媧諸神啟動“封神計畫顛覆商朝統治,安排了九尾妖狐上身妲己前來迷惑紂王。而紂王日漸傾心妲己對她專寵無度,更不服神旨逆天而行,建摘星樓登天問道與神對抗,並受申公豹挑唆殘害忠良,百姓苦不堪言。姜子牙助四..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set by Goddess Nu Wa to overthrow the Shang dynasty, Consort Da Ji is possessed by the Demon Fox to bewitch Emperor Zhou. Zhou spoils Da Ji by building a tower to heaven against Gods will, and even oppresses his people. Jiang Zi Ya steps up to help fight the Emperor, starting a war between the humans, the gods and the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金蓮是扶桑之寶,卻被紅狐紅綃、白狐傾城及黑狐夜桑在爭奪時意外遺失。扶桑之主姥姥本想利用金蓮意圖掌控天下,立即命令三狐下凡往人間尋找金蓮。三狐發現金蓮附身在一個名叫張懷生的人身上,而金蓮的力量亦恢復了各..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Golden Lotus, the Fusos treasure, is lost. Fusos demoness orders three fox demons to find it in the human world. The fox demons soon discover that Zhang Huai Shen has taken the golden lotus, which has the power to recall the memories of past lives. This eventually uncovers the relationship between Zhang, the three fox demons and the demoness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

epg.programme_title_en: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛山刑警林岩成立精英專案小組,專門重拳打擊囂張跋扈的街頭飛車大盜及其幕後龐大的犯罪集團。然而,當他身懷六甲的妻子慘遭猖狂飛車賊蓄意撞擊,生死未卜之時,極度悲憤的他意外揭開了一場隱匿在黑惡勢力深處的兇險..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與馬來西亞的得獎女演員Siti Saleha 及其丈夫一起探索香港的白天与黑夜,感受這座城市充滿活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join award-winning Malaysian actress Siti Saleha and her husband as they explore the city by day and venture into the night, discovering its vibrant culture and hidden treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Erin,一名飽受創傷與怒火困擾的女子,前往偏遠莊園探訪男友的家人,卻發現對方竟是操控血腥交易的邪教。當她被擄並成為獵物時,壓抑已久的怒火徹底爆發,反轉局勢,展開一場殘酷的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一場發生在三國動盪時期的史詩式之旅。曹操試圖招攬關羽加入他的陣營,但關羽忠於他的結拜兄弟劉備,也是曹操的敵人。當關羽試圖從曹操手上救出劉備的小妾時,迫於無奈要大開殺戒。最後他能否殺出重圍?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 千年前,青蛇在道清的點化下逐漸開化,生出與道清相守之心。因自己對道清的執念,卻導致道清進入輪迴之劫,遭受世間橫死之難。為了化解道清的劫難,數百年間,青蛇不斷尋找轉世的道清…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達州以其沙質海岸而聞名 - 而且有很多地方可供參觀.佛羅里達擁有美國大陸任何一個州最多潮汐的海岸線.這些海濱遊樂場亦是受著威脅和瀕危物種的重要棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Florida is famous for its sandy shores-and theres plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries an...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the rescue team as they respond to a call about an opossum stuck in a fence that turns out not to be the kind of animal that plays dead. Inside the center, a goose with a serious foot injury receives physiotherapy before returning to the wild.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解鸚鵡和鴨嘴獸如何讓人發展出新事業,並窺視一個讓人類和大象終身相伴的共同創傷.本集還會拜訪35歲的火雞兀鷹喬治,並見證一場與袋鼠的道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物,水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在諾華斯高沙省的任何一個邊界,證明任何海灘都是由相反的原始力量所建成,但若生命要茁壯成長,這些力量之間的平衡也是必要的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光.牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖.但因惡劣的地形,無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難.只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spiders help, trek with the guardian of Earths last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解鸚鵡和鴨嘴獸如何讓人發展出新事業,並窺視一個讓人類和大象終身相伴的共同創傷.本集還會拜訪35歲的火雞兀鷹喬治,並見證一場與袋鼠的道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow an injured opossum into surgery, as the medical team realizes amputation may be the only way to save his badly injured toe. And meet some turtle hatchlings who seem ready for release when the team gets disappointing details about their size.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一隻雞穿梭整個美國,並到英國拜訪一個棲居於花園的老鼠家族.正所謂以毒攻毒,見證人們如何在蜘蛛的幫助下克服蜘蛛恐懼症,與守護著地球上最後兩隻北部白犀牛的志願者同行,並為更多跨物種的友情而喝采.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨西哥尤卡坦半島是海龜和馬尾藻的家園,同時也是旅遊聖地;三者如何和諧共存?這個寶地可以持續發展嗎?揭開這個墨西哥海灘背後的秘密,包括每年舉行的一個古老分娩儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yucatán Peninsula is home to tourists, sea turtles, and sargassum seaweed. How do the three coexist in harmony? Is it sustainable? Uncover the secrets behind this Mexican beach, including an ancient birthing ritual that takes place each year.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the centers aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food. Then the rescue team works with the Ministry of Natural Resources to relocate a coyote thats too people-friendly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊.受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非的大克魯格國家公園,一頭名為青加的幼崽出生在馬啦馬啦獅群這個獵人世家中.在忠實的父親,嚴母和淘氣的姐姐指導下,青加找到她在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In South Africas Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小獵豹烏珊娜生長在不利環境中.很少小獵豹能夠撐過一歲.但她很幸運,有一位厲害的母親,她會不惜一切保護幼崽安全.烏珊娜只需跟隨她的腳步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, shes got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西卡皮瓦拉山脈國家公園裡,小卷尾猴施高正學習如何融入規則複雜的族群,並探索充滿刺激和危機處處的森林.但純熟地掌控工具才是他的生存關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Brazils Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度,年幼獅尾猴華菲面對著不斷縮小的棲息地和人類世界的侵擾.幸運的是,他有一位慈母,一位防範的父親,一位淘氣的姐姐,以及眾多親戚都在看顧他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物,水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是尚比亞兩隻黑犀牛的關鍵時刻. 四歲的雌性押臣和十四歲的公牛肯高是複雜的重置任務的核心,這是宏偉的拯救物種計劃的一部分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a critical time for two black rhinos in Zambia. Four year old female Apson and fourteen year old bull Kango are at the core of a complex relocation mission thats part of a grand plan to save a species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在尚比亞最大和最野生的保護區卡富埃國家公園深處,來自「尚比亞肉食性動物計劃」的生物學家和獸醫團隊爭分奪秒地拯救和保護非洲的頂級掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in Kafue National Park, the largest and wildest protected area in Zambia, a team of biologists and vets from the Zambian Carnivore Programme (ZCP) races against time to save and protect Africas apex predators.
