epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅.雞腳,添好運,掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu heads to Hong Kong, the fourth country on his around the world tour, and he has some great food excursions lined up. Chicken feet, Tim Ho Wan, street food and lots to fit in before he jumps across the pond to Tokyo, Japan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京.這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家.美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗.環遊世界.三十天.花費20,000美元.馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利託利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅.雞腳,添好運,掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu heads to Hong Kong, the fourth country on his around the world tour, and he has some great food excursions lined up. Chicken feet, Tim Ho Wan, street food and lots to fit in before he jumps across the pond to Tokyo, Japan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京.這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家.美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗.環遊世界.三十天.花費20,000美元.馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背後的未知故事,包括非洲時尚,一塊肯特布料,一張詹姆斯・巴納攝影作品,以及一隻令人困惑的古波斯餐盤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: VA curators uncover untold stories in objects, featuring African fashion, a kente cloth, a James Barnor photograph, and a puzzling Ancient Persian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週《博物館的秘密》聚焦產業與設計.策展人馬丁準備展出莫裡斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, Secrets of the Museum spotlights industry and design. Curator Martin preps a Maurice Broomfield photo exhibit, while Jenny receives a rare Biba production file. Also featured: a jamdani stole and Josiah Wedgwoods pottery trials.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家.它們就是迷人的義大利島國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物.冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力.從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週《博物館的秘密》聚焦產業與設計.策展人馬丁準備展出莫裡斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週,修復師 Adriana 清潔一座唐納泰羅雕像,西蒙收到海倫・米倫在《女王登場》中穿過的戲服,克裡斯多福會見設計師肯尼斯・格蘭奇爵士,而 VA 鄧迪館邀請藝術家 Yinka Ilori 設計一座色彩繽紛的迷宮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, conservator Adriana cleans a Donatello sculpture, Simon receives Helen Mirrens costume from The Audience, Christopher meets designer Sir Kenneth Grange, and VA Dundee recruits artist Yinka Ilori for a colorful maze.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風,涼意和大雨的季節.野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.

Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.

The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years. 

The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
As the world is gradually turning more vegetarian, and its metropolitan cities are
adopting more juice and salad bars into their restaurant culture, Samira heads
back to India to explore its vast vegetarian cuisine and its origins…

In this episode, Samira traces the roots of vegetarianism in India, in temples as food for the gods, solves the mystery of the giant family paper Dosa, gives healthy tips and tricks on quick and easy vegetarian snacks and explores the amazing Teas of India and ends up cooking some delicious Indian fritters to go with her cup of cha!

There are enough tips for the home chef to try at home. Samira tries her own hand with new ideas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food is becoming a staple in most big cities around the world. But its desserts have taken a back seat to some of its popular main courses. Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. Flavored kulfi (Indian Ice Creams) Indian Funnel Cakes or Jalebi,Gulab Jamun and fusion desserts like a Phirni cheese cake, an Indian rice pudding.

She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Indian food is becoming a staple in most big cities around the world. But its desserts have taken a back seat to some of its popular main courses. Samira finds out all about the spectacular buffet of desserts India has to offer, before making some in her own kitchen. Telling her viewers, the history of Indian sweets starting with its beginnings as devotional, spiritual temple food for the Gods, before learning how to make them. Flavored kulfi (Indian Ice Creams) Indian Funnel Cakes or Jalebi,Gulab Jamun and fusion desserts like a Phirni cheese cake, an Indian rice pudding.

She ends up back home in New York eating cupcakes from one of her favorite bakeries in Times Square.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.

The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years. 

The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.programme_title_tc: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.programme_title_en: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Banning its news feature in Australia, Facebook draws international condemnation. But how does the social media giant regulate its content, in an era marked by insidious fake news? This alarming documentary offers unique undercover access to Facebook’s moderating hub. It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights. Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement. Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Afghanistan's first ski team reach for a brighter future Where the Light ShinesFrom their amateur efforts at home in the Bamyan peaks, Sajjad and Alishah have the chance to ski for Afghanistan in the Winter Olympics. As local kids strap wood to their feet and imitate their heroes, the men face up to the difficulty of creating opportunities in a country that for generations has only seen war. Filmed over four years, this beautiful film paints an uplifting and refreshing portrait of Afghanistan as you haven't seen it before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring. While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises. Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections. Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care. “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first”. Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free”. The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures. Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world. “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger. 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

In the era of impending climate crisis, it's a more urgent story than ever

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Volkswagen Beetle is a design classic. Celebrated by the Nazis, and championed by Hitler, the Beetle's true origins were obscured by a web of intrigue, espionage and slander. This extraordinary doc reveals the untold story of Josef Ganz, the Jewish visionary behind one of the world's most adored cars. As relatives search for traces of Ganz's legacy, they seek to recover the genius of a man edited out of history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Incredible footage from ordinary Australians captured the ferocity of the bushfires that raged across the country this summer. These videos have been viewed tens of millions of times across the world, but who filmed them and how did their stories end? A team of reporters and producers fanned out across the country to track down the people who found themselves in the centre of the firestorms. What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the uplands of North East England, Tom and Kay Hutchinson set out on a near impossible task: to breed the perfect Swaledale Sheep. They toil through sun, hail, sleet and snow to rear their flock. Life on the fells is by turns idyllic and tough. Surrounded by an ever-changing and stunning landscape, the family battle against the weather, financial challenges and the bizarre propensity of sheep to suddenly drop dead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world. Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain. This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power. A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Incredible footage from ordinary Australians captured the ferocity of the bushfires that raged across the country this summer. These videos have been viewed tens of millions of times across the world, but who filmed them and how did their stories end? A team of reporters and producers fanned out across the country to track down the people who found themselves in the centre of the firestorms. What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the uplands of North East England, Tom and Kay Hutchinson set out on a near impossible task: to breed the perfect Swaledale Sheep. They toil through sun, hail, sleet and snow to rear their flock. Life on the fells is by turns idyllic and tough. Surrounded by an ever-changing and stunning landscape, the family battle against the weather, financial challenges and the bizarre propensity of sheep to suddenly drop dead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world. Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain. This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power. A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A compelling testimony to the possibilities of local activism, this environmental thriller follows investigative journalist, Matt Blomberg, and ocean activist, Paul Ferber, in their dangerous efforts to create a marine conservation area and combat the relentless tide of illegal fishing in Southeast Asia. Along the way a new generation of Cambodian environmentalists are inspired to create a better life for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Eco-activist Rod Coronado has made it his life's mission to advocate for the planet and the rights of animals. In 2014 he formed Wolf Patrol, an activist group which fights to end hunting of the grey wolves that roam Wisconsin’s forests. After 30 years of radical environmental action, which earned him the label 'eco-terrorist' and spells in prison, this intimate documentary follows Rod's journey to redefine his activism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dimitri is Fish Captain in Trouville-sur-Mer, Normandy. accompanied with his deckhands, Joris and Omar, embarked on a trawler, they track fishes… Far from their families from Monday to Friday, in the harshness of the job, they face the whims of the sea. Welcome aboard of “La Persévérance

Welcome aboard of “La Persévérance

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bob and Nancy Griffith made twenty ocean voyages over two decades, fulfilling a dream of freedom and adventure in their 53-foot sailboat. Nothing seemed impossible for this couple and their growing family as they travelled to some of the most remote places on earth, chronicling life at sea with their 16mm Bolex camera. As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On board a sleeper train crossing Tanzania, the stories of three passengers unfold. Rukia is an entrepreneurial woman, on her way to begin a new life. Isaya is an old Masai man heading back to the bush with his grandson. Peter, a powerful preacher, makes money by letting his followers pay for his services. This microcosm offers a glimpse into their lives as each character moves towards an uncertain future in this precarious society.

As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices.

As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On board a sleeper train crossing Tanzania, the stories of three passengers unfold. Rukia is an entrepreneurial woman, on her way to begin a new life. Isaya is an old Masai man heading back to the bush with his grandson. Peter, a powerful preacher, makes money by letting his followers pay for his services. This microcosm offers a glimpse into their lives as each character moves towards an uncertain future in this precarious society.

Welcome aboard of “La Persévérance

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Amazon plays a vital part in regulating the planet’s temperature. And yet, in the last year, forest destruction in the Brazilian Amazon soared by 85 per cent. The combination of illegal logging and slash and burn agriculture is decimating the land. With huge profits to be made, the Amazon is a dangerous place to ask questions. Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Deep In The Heart follows four patients, Lisa, Ted, Greg and Pat, as they deal with the emotional drama of major life-saving surgery. It’s an emotional story familiar to families up and down the country: skilled surgeons can fix bodies, but it’s up to the patients to make sure it doesn’t all go wrong again. All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality. Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Psychologist and filmmaker Eve always thought there was something not quite right about her family. A compelling tale of two defining human traits — endurance and frailty — and a metaphor for the 20th century’s most painful trauma.

epg.programme_title_tc: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.programme_title_en: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Banning its news feature in Australia, Facebook draws international condemnation. But how does the social media giant regulate its content, in an era marked by insidious fake news? This alarming documentary offers unique undercover access to Facebook’s moderating hub. It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits.

It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights. Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement. Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring. While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises. Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections. Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care. “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first”. Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free”. The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures. Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world. “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger. 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海軍罪案調查局接到電話調查一名縱火疑犯的動機,讓一場女孩之夜發生意想不到的轉折.另外,托利斯也努力尋找工作與生活的平衡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girls’ night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist. Also, Torres struggles to find work/life balance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落.一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名沉迷賭博的賭徒在一場高風險的豪賭中,輸掉了女兒雪莉娜的婚姻與全部遺產.雪莉娜被送進一座由冷酷婦人掌管的陰森神秘大宅,在那裡歷經背叛,並展開一段意想之外的浪漫戀情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A compulsive gambler risks and loses his daughter Serenas hand in marriage and her entire inheritance in a high-stakes wager. She is sent to live in a dark, mysterious mansion run by a cold lady, navigating betrayal and unexpected romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名劇作家沉迷於一張1912年美麗女演員的照片,並透過自我催眠穿越時空回到過去尋找她.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A playwright becomes obsessed with a photograph of a beautiful young actress from 1912 and travels back through time using self-hypnosis to find her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名愛德華時代的女記者發現了一個收錢辦事的買兇殺人暗殺組織.為了摧毀這個組織,她雇用該機構去刺殺其自家魅力十足的主席,進而在歐洲各地引發了一場致命的貓鼠遊戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An Edwardian journalist uncovers a secret society that assassinates for money. To dismantle it, she hires the bureau to kill its own charismatic chairman, triggering a deadly game of cat-and-mouse across Europe.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story of the legendary rock band Queen and lead singer Freddie Mercury, leading up to their famous performance at Live Aid (1985).

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans. This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.

This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground.  They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s. But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt. In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now... humpbacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: One of the most biodiverse places on the planet, the mysterious Amazon rainforest has spawned an equally diverse array of mysterious and iconic wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s. But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt. In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now... humpbacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans. This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.
